snippet.title: Hamsteria Itch Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Hamsteria is a difficult 2 Player Co-Op game about where you are hamsters. You each are in separate but connected hamster wheels, and you can only spin your wheel forwards and backwards. There is no turn, and there is no jump. To navigate, you must work together. 

Demo is avaliable for free on itch: https://2wheelerdev.itch.io/hamsteria
